description: Get full details for a TV show by TVMaze ID — genres, status, network/streaming channel, schedule (days/time), rating, premiere/end dates, runtime, IMDB/TheTVDB IDs, official site URL, and plain-text summary. Use show_search to find the TVMaze ID first. No auth required. Source: TVmaze.com (CC BY-SA).
